name: Debates in Indian Epistemology
description: The course will discuss epistemological debates on the definition of knowledge, classification of knowledge, sources of knowledge, and result of knowledge including false cognition in Indian theories of knowledge. The course will also rethink Indian epistemology from the perspectives of social epistemology and virtue epistemology.
